chaps: Avoid wiping slots when TPM daemon dies Stop treating "TPM daemon unavailable" errors as a signal to treat the slot's database corrupted. This should avoid the problem of wiping out legitimate slot contents because trunksd died during the slot's initialization in chapsd.
